title: A flow collection directly after the colon of a key that has only a tag
notes: A key made only of properties is a flow YAML node with an empty content (production 159, `c-ns-properties` then `e-node`), so the entry is production 145 and its value part is production 147 again: the `:` must be followed by white space before a value node. It is not a JSON-like key, so production 149 does not apply. In `{!t :{}}` the second `{`, at column 6, cannot continue the mapping. Compare diagnostics/empty-key-with-adjacent-flow-value-is-invalid.

provenance.reference: Found while reading the source of a library whose flow mapping reader accepted a flow collection right after the colon of a key with only a tag.
